title: Removing the lifted potential cross term exchanges the radial time derivative for a same-tier coefficient

radial_exchange.lifted_field: Set psi_n=Q^n phi and let F_n^PDE be K1413's positive graph energy including (lambda/2)int|phi|^2|psi_n|^2
radial_exchange.correction: Define R_n=-(lambda/2)int|phi|^2|psi_n|^2 and H_n=F_n^PDE+R_n, the positive quadratic covariant graph energy
radial_exchange.exact_identity: H_n'=int E dot j_n-lambda Re int |phi|^2<psi_n,D_t psi_n>
radial_exchange.same_tier_bound: Because H_n controls ||D_t psi_n||_2^2/2+m^2||psi_n||_2^2/2, the new radial work is bounded by (|lambda|/m)||phi||_infinity^2 H_n for m>0
radial_exchange.combined_k1558_identity: With M_n=int A dot j_n in K1558's temporal-gauge convention, (H_n+M_n)'=-lambda Re int |phi|^2<psi_n,D_t psi_n>+int A dot partial_t j_n
radial_exchange.advance: The difficult pointwise coefficient partial_t|phi|^2 is removed from the full-PDE graph estimate without a charge-tier shift; the differentiated-current term and coercivity of H_n+M_n remain open
radial_exchange.scope_guard: This is an exact normal-form exchange and same-tier radial estimate for smooth cutoff solutions with m>0. M_n is indefinite and adjacent-tier, and this result is not a coercive gauge-invariant modified energy, global H2 bound, charge summation, replacement of K1450 or completed flow
